description: Gantt Chart is the intuitive, high-performance project management visual for Microsoft Power BI. Plan and track project portfolios, construction schedules, product roadmaps, and agile sprints in one interactive timeline, with task hierarchies, dependencies, milestones, and planned vs. actual progress. Key Features WBS hierarchy: up to 10 levels of parent-child tasks with expand/collapse, optional WBS row numbers, and a resizable task column. Task dependencies: map Task ID and Predecessor ID to draw dependency arrows between linked tasks. Planned vs. actual progress: compare Actual (%) and Planned (%) on every bar, in Overlay or Strip style, with percentage data labels. Milestones: up to 5 milestone date columns per task, each with its own symbol (circle, diamond, square, triangle, star). Zero-duration tasks can display as milestones. Task owners: color-coded avatars with initials to spot resource bottlenecks and team workload at a glance. Task links: attach up to 3 URLs per task (specifications, tickets, documents) and open them from the chart. KPI columns: show up to 3 extra columns (budget, status, priority) next to the task list. Zoom & navigation: Day, Week, Month, Quarter, Year, or Automatic zoom. Zoom with Ctrl + mouse wheel or trackpad pinch, drag the timeline header to pan or stretch the timescale, and open the report on today, the project start, or the end. Working…
